description: Continuously ranks the configured AIFundOS watchlist plus a bounded set of U.S.-listed symbols discovered in fresh market news, detects material price/news/setup changes, and requests event-driven Committee review. Qualified ideas may enter the existing paper-only autonomous mandate.
immutable_guardrails: Discovery never sends a live brokerage order.
Only fresh intraday quotes may trigger Committee review or paper-order planning.
News-discovered symbols must be tagged to a recognized U.S. exchange and pass the same fresh-quote and Committee gates as configured symbols.
Risk Manager vetoes and portfolio limits remain binding.
A discovery event is not a trade until the Committee and autonomous paper mandate approve it.
Every scan, review, candidate handoff, and error is logged.
